name: monet-core
description: Monet — monorepo of the Monet creative suite (Anime, Artisan, Cinema, Galerie, Jouer, Rythme, Vision) on the shared Monet UI design system.

scripts.build:engines: pnpm --filter monet-artisan run engine:build:release && pnpm --filter monet-cinema run engine:build:release && pnpm --filter monet-vision run engine:build:release && pnpm --filter monet-galerie run engine:build:release
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present run test:unit && pnpm run test:docs
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm --filter ./apps/artisan run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/cinema run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/jouer run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/rythme run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/vision run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/anime run tauri build && pnpm --filter ./apps/galerie run tauri build
